result.description:
Role Purpose

The Senior Financial Accountant plays a key role in the core operations of our Finance Team. Specialist Risk Group Australia is a fast-growing specialist commercial insurance broker, and our finance function is the engine room that keeps the business measured, accountable and compliant as we scale.

Reporting to the CFO, you will take ownership of the numbers behind our growth, from the integrity of our general ledger through to the accuracy of our month-end and year-end reporting and the smooth running of our audit process. You will bring a proactive, solutions-focused mindset to a growing finance team, mentoring junior members while continuing to develop your own technical expertise.

This is a genuine opportunity to build financial processes and controls in a business at a pivotal stage of its growth, backed by an established international platform.

Key Responsibilities

•	Lead the month-end and year-end financial close processes, including journals, accruals, reconciliations and review of financial results. 
•	Prepare statutory financial statements and management reports in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards. 
•	Prepare financial reports and commentary for the CFO, executive management and board. 
•	Maintain the integrity of the general ledger and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial information. 
•	Manage the external audit process and coordinate responses to audit requirements. 
•	Prepare budget, forecast and prior-year variance analysis and advise management on financial performance. 
•	Develop and maintain accounting policies, financial procedures and internal control systems. 
•	Analyse operating costs, income, expenditure, cash flow and financial risks. 
•	Coordinate corporate income tax, GST, FBT, payroll tax and other statutory compliance obligations. 
•	Support acquisition due diligence, completion accounts, financial integration and harmonisation of accounting policies. 
•	Improve accounting systems, financial reporting tools and finance processes. 
•	Oversee payroll, accounts payable and expense control processes, including reconciliations and statutory compliance.

About You

•	CA or CPA qualified.
•	A minimum of four years' experience in financial accounting roles.
•	Current knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards.
•	Experience working within a large corporate environment.
•	Ability to manage competing priorities and meet strict deadlines.
•	Strong Excel skills and a high level of attention to detail.
•	Experience in ERP systems and financial reporting tools highly regarded.
•	Strong communication skills, with the confidence to partner across the business.
•	High level of integrity, professionalism and discretion.

About SRG Australia

Specialist Risk Group Australia is a specialist commercial insurance and employee benefits broker focused on complex, high-stakes risks across a range of industries. We are part of the broader SRG Group - an international specialist platform backed by Warburg Pincus and Temasek - with presence in the UK, Singapore, Europe and Australia.

About Us
South East Queensland Hauliers (SEQH) is a leading provider of transport, logistics, and warehousing solutions throughout Queensland.
Proudly family-owned and operated since the 1960s, SEQH has grown into one of Australia's largest import and export wharf carriers. With operations spanning Brisbane, Toowoomba, and the Port of Brisbane, we continue to invest in our people, our facilities, and our future.
About the Role
As a Professional Diesel Mechanic/Fitter, you will play a crucial role in fault diagnosis, repair and maintenance of company vehicles and equipment. Your responsibilities will vary depending on your experience level but may include:
•	Minimising plant and equipment downtime through proactive maintenance.
•	Diagnosing, inspecting, servicing, and repairing the fleet to ensure adherence to safety and quality standards.
•	Maintaining all company plant, equipment, and vehicles according to manufacturer's specifications.
•	Attending breakdowns and performing field-related mechanical repairs promptly.
•	Communicating safety or maintenance issues effectively and efficiently.
About You
•	3 years' experience as a Diesel Mechanic/Fitter.
•	Certification III in Heavy Machine Mechanic or Diesel Fitter
•	Strong technical skills and knowledge of diesel engine systems and components
•	Experience with Kone, Kalmar, Hyster, Sennebogen, Caterpillar preferred
•	Manual Licence essential
What We Offer
•	Competitive full-time rates up to $55 per hour, with overtime opportunities.
•	Enjoy a local, family-friendly Monday to Friday roster.
•	Join a supportive and collaborative work environment.
•	Access training opportunities to support professional development.
•	Benefit from weekly pay and competitive remuneration.
Why Join SEQH?
At SEQH, we believe great people come from all backgrounds. We hire for attitude and invest in training, development, and career growth.
If you're looking for more than just a job and want the opportunity to build a long-term career in a growing industry, we'd love to hear from you.
Applications can be submitted via Seek or email at IWantacareer@seqh.com.au.

Ensure designs comply with Australian Standards (AS/NZS), the National Construction Code (NCC), and relevant authority requirements. Assist with tender and construction documentation and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs).  Participate in project coordination meetings and provide technical support during construction.  Identify design risks, resolve engineering issues, and escalate complex matters to senior engineers where required.  Deliver assigned work within project timeframes, budgets, and quality standards.    Qualification & experience  Qualifications & Experience   Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Civil or Structural Engineering from a recognised tertiary institution.  Approximately  1–2 years' experience  in structural engineering within the building industry.  Experience in structural analysis, design, and documentation for commercial, residential, or mixed-use projects.  Knowledge of Australian Standards (AS/NZS), National Construction Code (NCC), and relevant engineering regulations.  Experience or demonstrated interest in  post-tensioned concrete design .  Experience using structural analysis and modelling software such as  ETABS, SAP2000, Strand7, SpaceGass, or similar .  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams.   The Skills We Need   Strong structural engineering and analytical skills.  Knowledge of structural modelling and engineering software.  Sound understanding of structural design principles and Australian engineering standards.  Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.  Strong organisational and time management skills.  Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills.  Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.  High level of attention to detail and commitment to quality.  Initiative, accountability, and willingness to continuously develop technical expertise.  Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting project deadlines. With offices across Australia, Northrop provides specialist services in structural, civil, geotechnical, sustainability, transport, and building services engineering for projects across the commercial, residential, education, health, industrial, government, and infrastructure sectors.  At Northrop, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Trading under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Senior Account Executive (Also known as Senior Planning Executive, Senior Client Executive)

The purpose of the Senior Planning Executive role is to autonomously plan and implement client campaigns -they are ultimately responsible for the delivery of all client activity. They will help lead the delivery of communication plans and management of digital campaigns from buying and implementation through to reporting and the delivery of holistic campaign learnings.  The Senior Planning Executive is to work in collaboration with the wider team to deliver integrated and creative plans that considers all vehicles (display, SEM, SEO, Social) and mainstream media at every possible opportunity. The Senior Planning Executive ensures attention to detail in all facets of their work and will take responsibility for any errors that occur.  Experience required: Minimum 3-4 years’ experience understanding and working knowledge of Australian Media Landscape and digital marketing advertising. Preferably a University degree or higher education qualifications. Expert understanding and working knowledge of Australian medialandscape. Expert across the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Have an understanding and experience using the following tools: eTAM, BMD, Roy Morgan, EMMA, eRAM, Nielsen Digital / Answers, Sizmek and/or DCM, MOVE, AQX Fusion

Account Manager (Also known as Client Manager, Planning Manager, Associate Account Manager, Associate Client Manager, Associate Planning Manager)

This role requires skills in creativity, media planning, media marketplace, tools and market dynamics. The Account Manager is also responsible for directly managing any Co-ordinators and Planning Executives within the client team and supporting the senior client leads in managing the client relationship through regular communication, presentations, WIP’s, and financial process.  Experience Required:  3-4 years’ industry experience. Expert across the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Possess sound financial management skills. Strong media understanding including an understanding and experience in using the full suite of media planning and measurement tools.
Salary: $80k-$100k package

Associate Account Director (Also known as Associate Client Director, Associate Planning Director, Senior Account Manager, Senior Planning Manager, Senior Client Manager)

This role is focused around communications planning, account service and leading a team of direct and indirect reports. For this role, we require someone who is comfortable in establishing and owning senior level client relationships and helping drive the client forward in regards to their media/marketing plans. This role also offers you the opportunity to test and learn new things allowing you to be at the forefront of new learning. The purpose of the Associate Account Director is to ensure that client service is of an exceptionally high standard. The Associate Account Director works closely with the Account Director and/or Business Director and/or Group Business Director to ensure that the product delivered to clients is best in class and in line with the agency’s values.  Experience required: 4-5 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client Leadership ,excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen ,strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.
Salary: $90k-$110k package 

Account Director (Also known as Client Director, Planning Director)
The purpose of the Account Director is to lead the development of media strategy and communication plans across their client portfolio. They are ultimately responsible for their teams work & output. They must ensure attention to detail in all facets of their teams work and take responsibility for any errors that occur. It is expected that they will participate in, embrace and lead training forums for their team and where applicable the common good of the agency. The Account Director is also responsible for developing long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with all clients - they should look to own the Marketing Manager level client relationship, and in some instances at the Marketing Director level. Account Directors will be called on to assist or lead New Business opportunities

Business Director (Also known as Client Partner)
This role is focused on driving client business relationship and deliver best in class business and communications solutions for clients.  The Business Director role includes: ultimate responsibility in overseeing and managing accounts, manage client expectations, anticipate client needs, resolve issues, identify client business requirements and work with team and cross functional teams to deliver the right solutions. Proactively source and present media / group solutions to help grow your client’s business 
Experience Required:  8-10 years industry experience at the minimum, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership ,excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels understanding of media systems.
Salary – over threshold 

Group Business Director (Also known as Client Partner)
Purpose of the role is to inspire and manage the client team and specialists to deliver world class work, service and partnerships. Deliver services and products that drives marketing led growth for our clients. Develop trusted and positive senior client relationships e.g. CMO, Marketing Director and ensure the agency team is acting as a true marketing partner. Develop internal and external client action plans that: Drives you and your team to deliver against client needs in a style which makes your client consider you their most valued business partner.  Identify opportunities to deliver marketing led growth via our diversified service. Custodian of the whole client contract, scope of work and have a plan in place to safeguard any upcoming renewals/negotiations (with General Manager/Managing Director).  Experience Required:  12-15 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership, excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.
Salary – over threshold 


All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
